description: Create invite codes. Requires admin or moderator role; with `community`, a PDS admin, or the community's owner while the server setting COMMUNITY_OWNER_INVITES is on. With `count`, creates that many independent codes with the same settings (one per person to invite).

main.description: Generate a new invite code with optional usage limits and expiration.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of times the invite code can be used. Defaults to 1.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the invite code.

boundTo.description: Optional email address the code is bound to; only that address can register with it.

note.description: Optional free-text note kept with the code, visible to admins in invite.list.

count.description: How many codes to create, each with these settings. Defaults to 1.

community.description: Make community invite codes (#403): used at sign-up, the account also joins this community, as if it had asked to join: at once under an open join policy, as a join request under approval; once the account is approved. Only a PDS admin, or the community's owner while the server setting "Community owners may create invite codes" (COMMUNITY_OWNER_INVITES) is on.

maxUses.description: Maximum number of uses for this invite code.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp, or null if the code does not expire.

boundTo.description: The email address the code is bound to, when one was given.

note.description: The note, when one was given.

codes.description: Every code created, in order; `code` is the first. Present when `count` was given.

community.description: The community the codes join, when one was given.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: With `community`: no such community, or not one the caller owns.

errors.name: CommunitySuspended
errors.description: The community has been suspended and takes no new members.

errors.name: CommunityTakenDown
errors.description: The community has been taken down.

errors.name: CommunityMoved
errors.description: The community has moved to another PDS.

errors.name: CommunityImporting
errors.description: The community is still arriving here and is not active yet.

errors.name: CommunityOwnerInvitesOff
errors.description: With `community`: the caller owns the community but is not a PDS admin, and this server lets only its admins create community invite codes (COMMUNITY_OWNER_INVITES is off).
